description: Count clinical trials for a condition or disease, broken down by recruitment status and by trial phase — how many are recruiting, completed, terminated, and how many are Phase 1, 2, 3 or 4. Use for landscape questions about how much trial activity a disease has and where it sits in development. Filtering by status or phase returns the filtered total without the breakdown.

phase.description: Optional phase filter: PHASE1, PHASE2, PHASE3, PHASE4

status.description: Optional status filter: RECRUITING, COMPLETED, etc.

title: Ct Count By Condition
